instructions: Complete the flow-chart below. Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the passage for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
stem_block:
From first sighting to an official name

The Near-Infrared Camera records a run of long exposures, each of (1) ........ , as a faint speck is followed against the background of stars.
    ↓
The speck is accepted as a body circling Uranus and is entered in the records under the provisional (2) ........ S/2025 U1.
    ↓
As the object is too faint to measure directly, its width is put at some ten kilometres, on the assumption that it (3) ........ light much as Uranus's other small moons do.
    ↓
Its path proves to be almost circular and to lie in the gap between Bianca and (4) ........ , not far from the plane of the planet's equator.
    ↓
The moon is counted as the (5) ........ member of the planet's crowd of small inner satellites.
    ↓
A lasting name, drawn from plays and poetry rather than from myth, still has to be approved by the (6) ........ .

items.prompt: The Near-Infrared Camera records a run of long exposures, each of (1) ........ , as a faint speck is followed against the background of stars.
items.evidence: On 2 February 2025, Webb's Near-Infrared Camera captured a series of ten long-exposure images, each lasting forty minutes, over a period of roughly six hours, tracking a faint point of light moving against the background of stars in a pattern consistent with an object orbiting Uranus itself.
items.explanation: Paragraph B says Webb's Near-Infrared Camera captured a series of long-exposure images, each lasting forty minutes; the gap asks how long a single exposure ran, so the answer is 'forty minutes'.
items.flag_reason: Parça gösterilmeden anlamca 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: farklı kelimeyle ama doğru kavramla cevaplandı (3 turda da '40 minutes' verdi, gerçek cevap 'forty minutes' — aynı sayının rakamla yazılışı).

revision.onceki_prompt: The Near-Infrared Camera records ten long exposures, each of (1) ........ , while a faint speck is followed against the star background for roughly six hours.
revision.ne_degisti: Kutu hem poz sayisini ('ten') hem toplam sureyi ('roughly six hours') veriyordu; 6 saat / 10 = 36 ~ 40 dakika islemi cevabi pasaja hic bakmadan veriyordu. Sizinti burada esdizim degil aritmetikti; iki sayi da kutudan cikarildi ve akis semasinin baska bir yerinde tekrar edilmedi.

items.prompt: The speck is accepted as a body circling Uranus and is entered in the records under the provisional (2) ........ S/2025 U1.
items.evidence: The newly found body has been given the provisional designation S/2025 U1.
items.explanation: Paragraph C says the newly found body has been given the provisional designation S/2025 U1; so the answer is 'designation'.
items.flag_reason: Cevap 'designation', yeni kesfedilen gok cisimlerine resmi isim verilmeden once 'gecici designation' (kod) atanmasi astronomideki yerlesik, yaygin bilinen bir uygulama; bu genel bilgiyle bosluk parcaya bakmadan da doldurulabiliyor.
items.reject_reason: Cevabin kendisi yerlesik bir astronomi terimi: yeni bulunan gok cisimlerine kalici ad verilmeden once 'provisional designation' atanmasi adlandirma geleneginin kendisidir ve S/2025 U1 bicimindeki kod bu terimin isaretidir; model uc turda da 'designation' yazdi (3/3 PUAN). Kutudan 'provisional' sozcugunu kaldirmak yetmiyor, cunku sizdiran sey sifat degil adlandirma gelenegini bilmek. E6 onerisi: C paragrafinin gozlem ayrintisi - cismin kac pozda izlendigi ya da hangi tarihte kaydedildigi.

items.prompt: As the object is too faint to measure directly, its width is put at some ten kilometres, on the assumption that it (3) ........ light much as Uranus's other small moons do.
items.evidence: Because it has not been imaged in enough detail to measure directly, its size has to be estimated: assuming it reflects light in a similar way to Uranus's other small moons, astronomers calculate a diameter of about six miles, or ten kilometres, making it one of the smallest moons known anywhere in the solar system.
items.explanation: Paragraph C states that the diameter estimate rests on the assumption that the object reflects light in a similar way to Uranus's other small moons; the gap asks for the verb in this assumption, so the answer is 'reflects'.
items.flag_reason: Bosluk 'on the assumption that it ___ light much as ... other small moons do' kalibinin ucunda; gok cisimleri icin 'isigi yansitmak' (reflect light) en dogal ve yaygin fiil oldugu icin parcaya bakmadan da tahmin edilebiliyor.
items.reject_reason: Bosluk 'it ___ light' kalibinin ortasinda ve bir gok cisminin parlakligindan cap tahmin etme varsayimi Ingilizcede yalniz 'reflect' fiiliyle kuruluyor. Fiili baska bir cerceveye tasimak ya cumleyi bozuyor ya da cevabi sifat bicimine ('reflective') ceviriyor, yani korunan alani degistiriyor. E6 bu adimi cap tahmininin sayisina ya da 'too faint to measure directly' gerekcesine capalamali.

items.prompt: Its path proves to be almost circular and to lie in the gap between Bianca and (4) ........ , not far from the plane of the planet's equator.
items.evidence: Its orbit lies roughly 35,000 miles, or 56,000 kilometres, from the centre of Uranus, in the gap between two previously known moons, Ophelia and Bianca.
items.explanation: Paragraph D says the orbit lies in the gap between two previously known moons, Ophelia and Bianca; since Bianca is already given in the question, the answer is 'Ophelia'.

items.prompt: The moon is counted as the (5) ........ member of the planet's crowd of small inner satellites.
items.evidence: With this addition, Uranus's known moon count rises to twenty-nine, and the new object becomes the fourteenth member of its group of small inner moons, a crowd that orbits far closer to the planet than its five largest and best-known satellites, Miranda, Ariel, Umbriel, Titania and Oberon.
items.explanation: Paragraph E says the new object is the fourteenth member of the group of small inner moons; the number twenty-nine is the total count of all of Uranus's known moons, so the answer is 'fourteenth'.
items.flag_reason: Net bir mekanizma yok: bosluk kucuk ic uydular grubundaki sira numarasini istiyor, bu sayi parcaya bakmadan tahmin edilemeyecek kadar spesifik; dogru sayinin (fourteenth) tutturulmasi buyuk olcude sansa dayaniyor.
items.review_note: E5 / 6. calistirma: dokunulmadi. E1'in gerekcesi boslugun istedigi sira numarasinin 'parcaya bakmadan tahmin edilemeyecek kadar spesifik' oldugunu soyluyor - yani gerekce sizintiyi degil sizintinin yoklugunu anlatiyor; blind_basis 'guess'. 4. calistirma ayni akis semasinin 1. kutusundaki hesaplanabilir bosluk sorununu zaten kapatmisti. Duzeltme yapilmadi, E7 yeniden olcmeli.

items.prompt: A lasting name, drawn from plays and poetry rather than from myth, still has to be approved by the (6) ........ .
items.evidence: Following long tradition, Uranus's moons are named not after figures from classical mythology, as is usual elsewhere in the solar system, but after characters drawn from the plays of Shakespeare and the poetry of Alexander Pope; the newcomer's eventual name will still need formal approval from the International Astronomical Union.
items.explanation: Paragraph E states that the moon's lasting name requires formal approval from the International Astronomical Union; so the answer is 'International Astronomical Union'.
items.flag_reason: Cevap 'International Astronomical Union', gok cismi adlarinin resmi onayini veren kurulusun Uluslararasi Astronomi Birligi olmasi astronomide yaygin bilinen bir gercek; bu genel bilgiyle bosluk parcaya bakmadan da doldurulabiliyor.
items.reject_reason: Cevabin kendisi bir ozel ad ve dunya bilgisi: gok cismi adlarini onaylayan kurumun Uluslararasi Astronomi Birligi olmasi astronominin en cok bilinen kurumsal gercegi; model uc turda da adin tamamini yazdi (3/3 PUAN). Kutunun kalan icerigi (Shakespeare ve Pope gelenegi) degistirilse bile 'onaylayan kurum' sorusunun tek cevabi ayni kalir. E6 onerisi: E/2'nin gelenek yarisi - adlarin mitolojiden degil oyun ve siirden secilmesi.
